data.title: Arthur Hayes says Bitcoin could hit $1 million after the next AI bailout
data.description: In a Substack post published on Wednesday, Hayes said the current AI boom is being misclassified by markets. Investors treat the multi-trillion-dollar buildout of data centers and power plants as pure technology growth. In reality, he argued, it more closely resembles commercial real estate ...
